title: Vanishing sum of signed $c$-vs-$a$ preferences
statement:
For each of the six strict orderings $k\in\{0,1,\dots,5\}$ of three alternatives, let $b_k\in\mathrm{Bool}$ record the $c$-vs-$a$ preference of ordering $k$, and encode it as a sign by $\sigma(b_k)=1$ when $b_k$ is false and $\sigma(b_k)=-1$ when $b_k$ is true. Then these six signed preferences sum to zero:
\[
  \sum_{k=0}^{5} \sigma(b_k) = 0.
\]
hypotheses_covered: sum ranges over all six orderings k in {0,...,5}
summand is the sign encoding applied to the c-vs-a preference of ordering k
replaced:
Summing the signed $c$-vs-$a$ preference over all six orderings gives
$\sum_{k=0}^{5} s_{ca}(k) = 0$; the $ca$ marginal is balanced.
